title: Association parameters
description: The association parameters a keycard may state for one component, and the canonical unit each is converted to. This is the single declaration the two implementations and the keycard generator hold themselves to, so a parameter one carries and another does not is a test failure rather than a drift. The fitted attraction and covolume are stated in SI, as every other parameter a card carries is, and not in the source table's internal scale.

scheme.description: The site scheme, which fixes the site count. A closed vocabulary because the schemes are not interchangeable: `2A` and `2B` both carry two sites and bond differently, and NeqSim's `CPAMixingRuleHandler.setAssociationScheme` switches on the name rather than the count.

energy.description: The association energy epsilon, which is what the site-fraction solve's Boltzmann factor is taken of.

volume_srk.description: The association volume kappa_AB of the SRK family: the fraction of the covolume over which a site may bond.

a_srk.description: The fitted attraction of the SRK family.

b_srk.description: The fitted covolume of the SRK family, which replaces the `0.08664 R Tc/Pc` the cubic derives.

m_srk.description: The SRK alpha correlation's coefficient, which replaces the acentric-factor form.

volume_pr.description: The association volume kappa_AB of the PR family.

a_pr.description: The fitted attraction of the PR family.

b_pr.description: The fitted covolume of the PR family.
